symbols.name: password_submitted
symbols.description: A user has submitted a password for login

symbols.name: password_correct
symbols.description: The submitted password matches the stored password for the account

symbols.name: access_granted
symbols.description: The system grants access to the user

symbols.name: access_denied
symbols.description: The system denies access to the user

symbols.name: failed_attempts_count
symbols.description: The number of consecutive failed login attempts for the account

symbols.name: account_locked
symbols.description: The account is currently in a locked state

symbols.name: account_is_admin
symbols.description: The account belongs to an administrator

background.text: The number of consecutive failed login attempts cannot be negative.
The system cannot grant access and deny access simultaneously.

rules.text: WHEN a user submits a correct password THEN the system grants access
rules.reading: In any situation where a user submits a password that is correct, the system must grant access to that user.

probes.reading: If the user submits a password, then the system grants access only if the password is correct.

rules.text: WHEN a user submits an incorrect password THEN the system denies access
rules.reading: If a user submits a password that does not match the stored password, the system must deny access.

probes.reading: If a user submits a password, the system denies access only if the password is incorrect.
The system denies access whenever the submitted password is incorrect, regardless of whether a submission event is explicitly recorded.

rules.text: WHEN the number of failed attempts on an account reaches 5 THEN the system locks the account
rules.reading: If the number of consecutive failed login attempts for an account equals 5, the system must place the account in a locked state.

probes.reading: If the number of consecutive failed login attempts for an account is at least 5, the system must place the account in a locked state.

rules.text: WHEN a user submits a password for a locked account THEN the system denies access
rules.reading: If a user submits a password for an account that is currently locked, the system must deny access.

probes.reading: If a user submits a password, the system denies access only if the account is locked.

rules.text: WHEN the account belongs to an administrator THEN the system does not lock the account
rules.reading: If the account belongs to an administrator, the account must not be in a locked state.
